entities.name: Embereck
entities.description: Elemental planeswalker native to Dominaria, the Ash Warlord, specializing in red mana; killed by Ravidel.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Rival who possessed the Golgothian Sylex and killed Embereck in the Planeswalker War.

entities.name: Eskil
entities.description: Planeswalker whose dwelling in the White Woods Embereck destroyed; he escaped unharmed.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Ancient artifact that resurfaced after the Ice Age and was held by Ravidel.

entities.name: Gathering of the Sages of Minorad
entities.description: Council of sages that Embereck joined and later left.

entities.name: Planeswalker War
entities.description: War in which Embereck fought and was killed.

entities.name: Mox Beacon
entities.description: Beacon whose activation called Embereck back to Corondor.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Dominarian region Embereck was called back to.

events.summary: Embereck fights Ravidel over the resurfaced Golgothian Sylex; Ravidel is left in possession of it.
events.quote: Embereck fought Ravidel over the resurfaced Golgothian Sylex

events.summary: Embereck joins the Gathering of the Sages of Minorad but leaves when they decide not to interfere with Ravidel.
participants: Gathering of the Sages of Minorad
events.quote: Embereck joined the Gathering of the Sages of Minorad but left the council

events.summary: Embereck destroys Eskil's dwelling, wrongly blaming him for the Mox Beacon.
events.quote: Embereck destroyed Eskil's dwelling in the White Woods

events.summary: Embereck agrees to join the battle against Ravidel.
events.quote: Embereck agreed to join the battle.

events.summary: Embereck is overpowered and killed by Ravidel in the Planeswalker War.
events.quote: was overpowered and killed by Ravidel

relations.note: Overpowered and killed him in the war.

relations.quote: Embereck fought Ravidel over the resurfaced Golgothian Sylex
